description:
Ever since they first met when they were seventeen, right up until now, at the age of twenty-two, Moon Gyeol has been secretly in love with his same-aged friend Do Yijae.

Although he wouldn’t dream of confessing his feelings for fear that Yijae might feel betrayed if he found out, Gyeol ends up staying at Yijae’s house—where Yijae lives alone—after a problem arises with his own apartment.

*“Am I supposed to sleep in the study?”  
“The study? You’re sleeping with me, aren’t you?”*

Unaware of Gyeol’s feelings, Yijae suggests they sleep in the same bed, as if he were an animal longing for human warmth…

As if warning him not to approach other humans, Yijae coats Gyeol’s body thoroughly with his mysterious pheromones.

*“I’m in heat.”  
“I-in heat?”*

When his heat arrives, Yijae stirs instincts within Gyeol that are almost impossible to resist.

*“I want to make love with you.”*

Just how is Gyeol supposed to interpret Yijae's behaviour?

**Original Novel:**  
Volumes: [RIDI](https://ridibooks.com/books/3885017000), [MrBlue](https://www.mrblue.com/novel/E000110741)
